programmes.d: Notorious bank robber Byron Chubbuck escaped from New Mexico State Penitentiary in 2000.

The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.
On July 4, 1987, seven inmates broke out of a high-security prison in New Mexico.

In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.
In Boston, FBI agents tracked down a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns.

When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.
Two beloved professors at Dartmouth College are brutally murdered in their home.
Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.
A man arrives at the home of his mother and finds her lifeless body.
Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.
A gang based in the U.S. Virgin Islands smuggled large amounts of cocaine into mainland.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programmes.d: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.
On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programmes.d: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.
In 1982, a California highway patrol officer pulled a young woman over for speeding.

A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.
A letter to a newspaper provides a crucial clue to a murderer's identity.

A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.
A rapist and murderer is the nephew and cousin of his victims.

On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.
For two couples on vacation, an island paradise turned to hell when one couple murders the other.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programmes.d: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.
It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.
On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers were found lynched in the rural deep South.

On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.
Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, wandered the streets of New York.

A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.
No suspect had emerged after the rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984.
A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.
A loner and distrustful of authority, Claude Dallas lived off the land.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programmes.d: A mother and child are kidnapped, a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.
Ted Kaczynski was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years.

In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.
A 5-year-old girl disappears from a Christmas party and is never seen again.

Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.
Islamic terrorists are convicted in the 1993 World Trade Center bombing.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programmes.d: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.
A determined team tracked the flamboyant crime boss John Gotti.

In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.
Posing as a photographer, Christopher Wilder lured women from shopping malls with promises of fame.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programmes.d: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.
In 1993, a mother, her 8-year-old son and a live-in nurse were brutally murdered by an assassin.

When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.
Serial killer taunts victim's family.
When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.
A quiet Texas neighborhood was shattered in 1988 when a mother and child are kidnapped and murdered.
